title: W5: GATE — manual QA (sim-quick in Docker + isolation proof + sq_invocation) THEN Momus review
description:
MANDATORY final gate. Two parts:

MANUAL QA (run it yourself):
- HAPPY: just sim-quick (1 Warrior->L20) runs fully in a container; sqlite3 runs.db shows >=1 run row + tick_snapshots + runner progress line.
- ISOLATION (the point): docker run the sim image attempting to write a host path OUTSIDE /out -> FAILS / host file never appears. Assert concretely.
- DIAGNOSTIC: sq_invocation table populated (argv/stdout/stderr/exit_code). Forced-failure (SQ_DEBUG=1 + broken save) -> non-zero exit_code + stderr context captured in sq_invocation.
- ARENA: a run reaching min-arena-tier produces arena_attempt rows (PTY works in-container).
- REGRESSION: just report + just dashboard work host-native against merged runs.db; merge_dbs merges multiple shards incl sq_invocation.
- BINARY: SQ_DEBUG unset = behavior identical to pre-change (no player-visible difference); cargo test green.

THEN MOMUS (binding): invoke Momus with the full diff + scenarios + evidence. Verdict is binding; loop until UNCONDITIONAL approval. 6+ files across src/+sim+justfile+Dockerfile+docs.

DELEGATE: manual QA self-run + subagent_type=momus for review. BlockedBy W4 (everything complete).

title: EPIC: Dockerize balance-sim — one container per simulated character for FS isolation + diagnostic capture
description:
Refactor dev-tools/balance-sim so each simulated character runs in its own Docker container, giving a true OS-level filesystem jail. Motivation: sq will gain real-filesystem reach (events that read/write/traverse arbitrary host paths); tempdir $HOME isolation is then insufficient. Also add a diagnostic-capture path so binary bugs surfacing mid-sim are post-mortem debuggable.

CONFIRMED DESIGN (binding):
- Invocation: stdlib subprocess + docker run (NO docker-py; preserve 'stdlib only / dependencies=[]' + PEP723 uv-run invariant).
- Granularity: one container per (class x race x strategy x run) cell.
- Boundary: runner.py stays on host, keeps mp.Pool; each _worker does docker run; host merges shards (db.merge_dbs unchanged).
- In-container: full SimPlayer lifecycle + SQLite shard writes + arena PTY, via new simulator/container_main.py calling simulate_one().
- Mounts: host-built target/debug/sq ro; balance-sim code+schema.sql ro; rw output dir for shard; disposable container $HOME; HOST ROOT NEVER MOUNTED (the jail); --rm --network=none.
- Binary: host builds sq (just build); container consumes via ro mount; no cargo in image; python-slim image.
- Recipes: DOCKER-ONLY; just build + just sim-image are prereqs; report/dashboard/watch stay host-native (read-only on runs.db).
- Diagnostics sim-side: container sets RUST_BACKTRACE=full + SQ_DEBUG=1; driver.py records every sq invocation (argv/cwd/stdout/stderr/exit_code) into new sq_invocation shard table -> merges to runs.db.
- Diagnostics binary-side (src/): add SQ_DEBUG env (mirror SQ_NO_PACING in arena.rs:504). When set, cmd_tick (main.rs:394-411) logs load/save failures w/ context + exits non-zero; UNSET = byte-for-byte identical to today. Do NOT change events::tick() signature.

Reviewer Gate (Momus) is MANDATORY at the end (6+ files across src/ + sim + justfile + Dockerfile + docs).
